author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: Elon is so out of touch with reality.  I still need to work, I want to travel the world in private jets,  eat good food and do fun stuff with no line up.  I don't think AI can give everyone a private jet.

shared_article.title: Elon Musk Says AI and Robots Will Do 'So Much Stuff' We Run Out of Things for Humans to Do — But 'We'll Basically Just Issue Money to People'
